answer_1.quote: instruction tuning on Large Language Models (LLMs)  focus on creating large, varied, and high-quality datasets of various tasks with responses curated by human experts

answer_2.quote: we utilize 3 commonly used automatic evaluation metrics, including (1) Pair-wise Comparison, (2) Open LLM Leaderboard and (3) Alpaca Eval.

answer_3.quote: Figure  compares each Superfiltering-selecteddata finetuned model and the full-data finetuned model by using GPT-4 as a judge to decide their numbers of wins/ties/losses on a test set of instructions.

answer_4.quote: we conducted a further human study to evaluate the effectiveness of our method. Specifically, we randomly sample 100 instructions from the WizardLM test set to form a new instruction set. Then 3 human participants are given the task of comparing the responses generated by the comparing models with the criteria same as the previous pair-wise evaluation, i.e. Helpfulness, Relevance, Accuracy, and Level of Detail.
